mentions.name: Mutacortechs
mentions.description: An artificial life simulation in which each "organism" runs on its own emulated 16-bit processor with 64K RAM, described as like Core Wars for the 21st century. The project includes a designed ISA, a complete assembler, an emulator in progress (160 of 204 instructions implemented), and the start of the simulation; organisms written in custom assembly can look around, find food, move toward it, and eat it.
